result.consolidated: The system must prevent users from creating an accommodation or service booking that exceeds 7 consecutive nights.
decisions_required: The maximum duration is specified as '7 nights' (or 'up to 7 nights'), '7 consecutive days', and 'less than 8 days'. The precise unit and value must be confirmed.
The rule applies to 'accommodation' or 'stays' in most inputs, but one (170) specifies 'service bookings'. The scope of this rule must be confirmed.
One requirement (223) states the limit applies when booking 'through a dedicated section', while others imply it is a global rule. The context of the rule must be clarified.
